case_hash_audit: All 3 case-listed source files matched C3-CT-U6.json; all 115 common-source entries matched C3-COMMON.json.

star_audit.counts: i_0=1; i_1=m+1; i_j=C(m,j) for 2<=j<=m; i_j=0 for j>m
star_audit.first_descent: Delta_0=m; Delta_1=C(m,2)-(m+1)>=0; for 2<=j<m, Delta_j=C(m,j)*(m-2j-1)/(j+1); Delta_m=-1; hence x=floor((m-1)/2)+1
star_audit.selector_and_sum: Each leaf deletion is K_{1,m-1}; under the guards p is beyond its first negative-difference index and within the nonzero binomial range. All m original leaves are selected. Each summand is C(m-1,p)-C(m-1,p-1)<0, since p-1>(m-1)/2. Thus S=m*(C(m-1,p)-C(m-1,p-1))<0.
star_audit.same_support: All leaf tags are counted separately despite sharing the center as support.

operator_audit.map_well_defined: Each retained deletion remains independent and meets W, hence is a basis element of M_j.
operator_audit.implication: Injectivity of d_{k+1}:M_{k+1}->M_k gives q_v(k+1)<=q_v(k). The target summand equals Delta_k(H)-Delta_k(H-W)=q_v(k+1)-q_v(k). Pointwise nonpositivity across the fixed selector implies S<=0.
operator_audit.out_of_range_obstruction: For 19 isolated marked vertices, d_6 has dimensions C(19,6)=27132 and C(19,5)=11628, so it is noninjective; this rank is not selector-eligible in the cited star setting.

limitations: No injectivity premise is proved for arbitrary eligible tree residuals.
The star family result does not settle the arbitrary-tree aggregate.
No full-sum counterexample or independent computation was produced.
